correctness.rationale: The normal fan identifies the graph exactly with the induced Boolean cube after removing its two cyclic orientations. The commutator \(DU-UD=(n-2j)I\) proves exhaustive Boolean harmonic strings, with endpoints removed only from the trivial string. The \(r\ge2\) blocks therefore contribute all indicated even eigenvalues; \(r=0,1\) are exact tridiagonal continuants. A weighted-path cofactor and kernel norm give the radial pseudodeterminant \(\frac{(n-1)!(2^n-2)}{n}\); the unperturbed first-harmonic endpoint inverse and determinant lemma yield \(D_n\). Kirchhoff gives the evaluated product for every integer \(n\ge3\). Independent bitstring graph construction and 53 modular determinant evaluations at \(3\le n\le7\) passed, as did four exact integer cofactor comparisons at \(3\le n\le6\); \(3\le n\le30\) leading-minor tests also passed. The finite checks corroborate an analytical universal proof rather than purport to establish it.

value.rationale: The graphical zonotope of a cycle is a foundational, naturally parameterized polytope family beyond trees; its skeleton is a canonical punctured hypercube. The calculation determines the complete Laplacian characteristic polynomial for every dimension and yields a new explicit all-dimensional spanning-tree complexity formula for exponentially many vertices. The finite continuants isolate the only two harmonic blocks altered by antipodal deletion and the untouched Boolean-harmonic factors give structural meaning. This is a natural exact invariant of the polytope graph, not an arbitrary numerical slice, a generic normalization check, or merely an application of the matrix-tree theorem without evaluation.
